parsed.name: Wiltron 6672B 微波信号发生器
parsed.description: Wiltron 6672B 是一款微波信号发生器，可输出可调频率和幅度的射频/微波信号，适用于高频电路、器件与系统测试中的激励源与校准用途。
parsed.description_en: The Wiltron 6672B is a microwave signal generator that provides RF/microwave output with adjustable frequency and amplitude, suitable as a stimulus source for calibration and testing of high-frequency circuits, devices, and systems.

actions.description_en: Set or read the output frequency.
Set or read the output amplitude.
